confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Jakarta prices, with IDR converted at an assumed rate of roughly 16,500-17,500 per USD. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the firmest. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weak. Accommodation anchors carry the widest uncertainty (neighbourhood, taxes and fees; no peak-season premium assumed for July 2026).
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capitals with similar tourist and business price levels (for example Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Manila), adjusted for Jakarta's local food, alcohol-tax and hotel-rate levels. Accommodation is benchmarked to typical central-Jakarta hostel, budget-guesthouse and business-hotel rates, not to any named property.
